Derek Holt: AccountingBot just flagged a mismatch between Azure billing and our reserved instance amortization for project=zephyr. There's a $19,400 delta for Jun across on-demand vs reserved allocations. Can infra confirm what's up? :mag:
AccountingBot: Alert: Allocation mismatch detected for subscription zephyr-prod. Delta: $19,400 (Jun-2026). Top SKUs: NVidiaA100_v4 (on-demand), ReservedInstance amortization not applied to some line items. Export: https://billing.internal/exports/azure/zephyr-jun.csv
Mei Wang: looking into it 1: Azure's billing shows two charge types: Upfront RI purchase (capex) and Usage charges. Our invoice parser is supposed to amortize RI purchase into monthly credits. I see several on-demand usage rows billed to the shared-azure-pool because the VM scale set didn't have "billingTag:project" populated during a recent deployment.
Sylvia Ortega: that deployment was the Zephyr continuous-retraining rollout last month. we rolled a new VM image and missed the ARM template tag. i can backfill tags for VMs still extant, but historical usage will remain untagged for invoice attribution.
Noah Flynn: finance will need the lineItemIds and the RI amortization mapping to file with our Microsoft reseller. can infra export a CSV: lineItemId, usageStart, usageEnd, instanceId, sku, is_reserved_credit_applied?
Mei Wang: running the query now. here's the Kusto-like snippet we used on our billing export table: 
```
billing
| where InvoiceMonth == '2026-06'
| where tolower(SkuName) contains 'a100'
| extend project = tostring(Tags['billing:project'])
| summarize total_cost = sum(PreTaxCost), reserved_credit = sum(ReservedInstanceCredit) by InvoiceMonth, project, SkuName
| order by total_cost desc
```
Mei Wang: I'll drop the CSV to /shared/finance-temp/zephyr-azure-jun.csv once it finishes. estimate ~42 line items untagged, $12k of that is on-demand A100 hours, $7.4k is missing reserved credits.
Derek Holt: finance: provisional ok to move the $12k on-demand portion to Zephyr project pending infra CSV + manager sign-off. For the reserved-credit shortfall we prefer to ask the reseller for an amortization fix first.
AccountingBot: Recommendation: open Microsoft support case referencing invoice ID and include lineItemIds and proof of RI ownership (purchase order). If reseller declines amortization, finance can approve an internal charge transfer for remaining delta up to $5k.
Sylvia Ortega: PR opened to enforce billing:project tag in the ARM pipeline and a preflight validation in the rollout job. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/943. Also running retro-tag script for running VMs; will attach run list to CSV.
Noah Flynn: please include the RI purchase order number in the support case. Derek, can you confirm whether Zephyr team actually purchased the RI pool on 2026-04-15? finance record shows PO# ZPH-RI-0426.
Derek Holt: confirmed PO# ZPH-RI-0426 was for 6 x A100_v4 reserved 12-month term purchased 2026-04-15. i'll attach PO and approval chain to the vendor case.
Mei Wang: uploaded CSV: https://files.internal/shared/finance-temp/zephyr-azure-jun.csv. columns include lineItemId, usageStart, usageEnd, instanceId, sku, reserved_credit_flag, retro_tag_status.
Derek Holt: thanks. I'll draft the Microsoft reseller case: "Reserved Instance amortization not applied to usage rows due to missing billing tags; request reallocation/amortization per PO ZPH-RI-0426." Also will request manager sign-off for a provisional $12k transfer if vendor response is delayed. will post case number here when opened.
AccountingBot: Note: billing snapshot 2026-07-03T05:45:00Z. Suggested monitoring: alert when reserved_credit coverage < 60% for any project for a billing month. Add to #billing-alerts.
Derek Holt: Approved. Mei/Sylvia, please confirm when the ARM template PR merges and when retro tags finish so finance can finalize transfer or close the vendor case. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
